caption:
Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

Surah Taa-Haa (20:14). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #IslamicReminder #Ayah #Deen #IslamicGuidance

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-19) of GET /v1/ayah/20:14/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance."
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Raw: "我确是真主，除我外，绝无应受崇拜者。你应当崇拜我， 当为记念我而谨守拜功。". Punctuation/spacing-only fix (stray space after comma removed). No wording changed.
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "실로 내가 하나님이요 나 외에는 신이 없나니 나만을 경배하 고 예배하며 나만을 생각하라". Spacing-only fix: '하 고' -> '하고'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "本当にわれはアッラーである。われの外に神はない。だからわれに仕え，われを心に抱いて礼拝の務めを守れ。"
